rule.comparison: Both arms closed, original control replay verified against frozen source, errors excluded from paired totals. UNKNOWN controls separate. Never revise old admissions.
rule.costs: Source entry, quantity, target, expiry and costs unchanged; price-entry stop still loses fees/slippage/funding. Funding changes only with actual modeled holding time.
rule.execution: First full 1m bar after entry; original stop then target then timeout before arming; arm at close >=1 initial price-stop R; entry-price stop from next full minute; stop first on ambiguity, adverse open on stop gaps.
rule.review: Descriptive review after 14 days and 50 matched closed pairs; no automatic promotion or profitability claim.
rule.selection: All future source RANGE entries independent of OI/flow; id above registration watermark; opened_ms and signal bar_ms at/after registration. No replacements after an early variant exit.
rule.timing: Admission committed before outcomes/minute requests. Discovery over 180 seconds is permanently UNKNOWN. As-of source plans are observational labels, not executable fills.
